title: Gordium site description, gordium.site/1
description: The lot and buildings a design tool sends Gordium's checker, in feet. The words: site_description_v1.md. Checks this schema can't state (Gordium refuses them too): every id unique across the lot, buildings, unsent and left_out; each problem's args exactly its code's blanks; the lot outline at least 3 different points; grade source 'none' exactly when there are no grade points; numbers finite.

units.description: Feet only: the tool converts once, at its own boundary.

inventory_complete.description: true only when the tool looked at everything on the lot: false makes every building's measuring need review.

problems.description: Problems with the site as a whole (the lot outline, the file).

host.description: Which tool, version and file sent this, and the file's own units. For tracing only: never used in a decision.

lot.description: The lot outline as its lot lines, in order.

edge.description: One lot line: a straight line's two ends, or points closely along a curved one (curved: true).

building.description: One solid on the building layer, as its flat faces.

floor.description: A floor block's height as drawn (ft); null or left out for any other solid.

face.description: A flat face: its outline and any holes, each at least 3 points [x, y, z].

unsent.description: An object that may be building but couldn't be sent (a block, a surface).

left_out.description: An object on the lot that wasn't sent. Each one makes the check need review, but a slab marked patio (only the yards need review) or parking (changes nothing): see slab.

touching.description: Whether it touches a building sent; null: not known (then it counts as touching).

slab.description: Protocol 1.3: a slab on the ground outside the building (Revit: a Floor under none of the house's walls or roofs), by what the architect marked it. unmarked: it may be a porch, deck, landing or ramp, so lot coverage and the yards need review; patio (a patio, terrace or walk): not in lot coverage, but the yards need review (one above grade may not be in a required yard); parking (a parking area or driveway): not in lot coverage. Left out: not a slab.

name.description: The object's name in the tool (a Revit floor type, "Concrete 10\""), for the architect's reading only.

grade.description: The ground: the spot grades or terrain points read, or none.

problem.description: Why something can't be measured: a measuring stop's code and the text for its blanks.
